if: the inward supply is MEMBERSHIP OF A CLUB, or of a HEALTH AND FITNESS CENTRE
then: input tax credit is NOT AVAILABLE on that membership
note: Stated without any exception of its own in the source. The proviso about an employer being obliged by law to provide the benefit follows sub-clause (iii); this sub-clause carries no proviso in its own terms, and the same-category escape in the proviso to sub-clause (i) is attached to that sub-clause. Corporate membership taken in the company's name is still membership of a club. Section 17(5) opens 'Notwithstanding anything contained in sub-section (1) of section 16 and sub-section (1) of section 18', so this block defeats both the s.16(1) entitlement and the s.18(1) special-circumstances credit. Business use does not cure it. The source is the CGST Act as updated 31-08-2021. UNKNOWN whether a later amendment has changed this clause; later amendments are not held locally.
